params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal shot, square 1:1, dark warm palette. An empty modern office chair at a desk, seen from behind at a low angle; on the desk a laptop with a soft warm glow and a second monitor, no person anywhere. The chair is lit by a single warm rim light, the rest of the room fades into deep coffee-brown darkness. Upper 45% of the frame nearly black and empty for typography. No readable text on screens, no logos, no watermark. Calm, slightly melancholic, realistic.
